paper.title: TextGrad: Automatic "Differentiation" via Text
paper.central_claim: A fixed, easy-to-use textual automatic-differentiation framework improves compound-system variables out of the box across prompts, code, QA, molecules and treatment plans, with users supplying objectives rather than tuning framework prompts.

provenance.notes: 无独立收据不探测；只核作者报告。

gap.author_gap: Compound AI systems need general automated optimization across non-differentiable component types rather than manual heuristics or single-call prompt optimization.
